source: Final paper abstracts and retained public result summaries

bench-fragile-leaderboard.question: Which pairwise leaderboard claims are stable enough to state?
bench-fragile-leaderboard.headline: 15 stable · 300 abstained
bench-fragile-leaderboard.finding: Across 2,560 scored rows, simultaneous bands authorize only 15 of 315 pairwise claims; 53 pairs change direction under the observed evaluator-format axis.

cv-compositional-match.question: Does structured atom evidence improve a strong holistic scorer?
cv-compositional-match.headline: 0.953 fallback > 0.942 gate
cv-compositional-match.finding: Across 61,902 tasks, the gate records 0 gate-only wins and blocks 681 corrections made by the simpler fallback.

cv-frontier.question: Does a fixed risk gate protect useful test-time adaptation?
cv-frontier.headline: 2 / 1,880 DTD updates
cv-frontier.finding: The gate rejects nearly all DTD updates and gated accuracy is worse than native DOTA across all three evaluated families.

mm-gui-agent.question: Can a training-free selector delay costly wrong actions?
mm-gui-agent.headline: 0.0125 → 0.0115 risk area
mm-gui-agent.finding: A fixed surface prior reduces aggregate high-cost wrong-execution area, with a narrow family-wise gain on one of four benchmarks.

mm-hallucination.question: Do training-free wrappers change official answers in the intended direction?
mm-hallucination.headline: 15 cells · 4,500 rows
mm-hallucination.finding: Retained wrappers are normalized-answer no-ops or cause benchmark-specific degradation rather than a reliable mitigation gain.

quant-vocab-matrix.question: Can public row metadata identify precision-critical tokens?
quant-vocab-matrix.headline: 0 significant wins vs random
quant-vocab-matrix.finding: Across 18,934 scored rows, frequency, entity-membership, and row-norm proxies do not consistently beat random bypass controls.
